scratch.LESSON: A regex that matches nothing passes every input and arms a gate that can never fire. Reading the source did not reveal it because grep and sed render a 0x08 byte invisibly; only probing the helper with a known-positive did. Any new matcher gets a NOT-VACUOUS self-test in the same change.
scratch.LESSON_2: Verify a violation LANDED before trusting that the check failed. One plant here reported PLANTED and changed nothing (zero occurrences), and its exit 0 would have read as 'the guard does not work'. Assert the replacement count, then run.
